```sql
WITH rowesville_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Rowesville' AND addr_state ILIKE 'South Carolina'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM rowesville_geom), true) AS clipped_raster
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM rowesville_geom))
)
SELECT 
  MAX((ST_Value(clipped_raster, 1))::numeric) - MIN((ST_Value(clipped_raster, 1))::numeric) AS elevation_diff
FROM clipped_dem;
```
